content.user_title: Connect Your Claude Code Session to ThreadPage
content.value_statement: Connecting a session requires a clear request and a recognizable name. This skill requests a ThreadPage connection and returns its response after approval.
actual_capabilities: Requests one call to the ThreadPage threadpage_connect tool.
Passes a name when the command includes as <name>.
Omits the name argument otherwise, allowing the plugin to suggest one from the current folder.
Waits for the tool response and reports it in one line, including any returned link.
limitations: Requires the ThreadPage plugin and its connection tool; the skill includes no tool implementation.
The instructions target Claude Code; equivalent behavior in other hosts is not established.
Connection depends on user approval and may require a browser click.
Provides no instructions for disconnecting, retrying failed connections, or managing multiple sessions.

output_examples.output: Connection was not completed because approval was declined.

best_practices: Invoke the slash command explicitly when you want to connect the current session.
Choose a recognizable, non-sensitive session name when using the as argument.
Review the approval request and use only the link returned by the connection tool.
anti_patterns: Expecting the skill to connect automatically without an explicit command.
Putting credentials or confidential details in the session name.
Treating the connection as successful before the tool returns its result.

faq.question: How do I start the connection?
faq.answer: Type /threadpage:connect in Claude Code with the ThreadPage plugin available.

faq.question: Can I choose the session name?
faq.answer: Yes. Type /threadpage:connect as <name> with your preferred name.

faq.question: What happens when I omit the name?
faq.answer: The skill passes no name argument, and the plugin suggests one from the current folder.

faq.question: Does the connection require approval?
faq.answer: The instructions state that Claude Code asks before running the tool. ThreadPage may also require a browser click.

faq.question: What response should I expect?
faq.answer: The skill reports the tool response in one line and includes a link if the tool returns one.

faq.question: Does this skill work directly in Codex?
faq.answer: The source documents Claude Code only. It does not establish Codex support for the slash command, approval flow, or ThreadPage tool.
